name: Windows Search Management
description: Beperkt Windows Search tot lokale en M365-content. Webresultaten, Search Highlights, locatiegebruik en Uitgebreid zoeken (Find My Files) zijn uitgeschakeld. Versleutelde bestanden en verwisselbare schijven worden niet geïndexeerd, en externe zoekopdrachten op de index zijn geblokkeerd. Cloud Search blijft toegestaan, zodat OneDrive- en SharePoint-content vindbaar is.

settings.name: Allow Cloud Search
settings.description: Allows Windows Search to search cloud sources such as OneDrive and SharePoint.
settings.rationale: Keeping Cloud Search enabled ensures that content stored in OneDrive and SharePoint remains discoverable through Windows Search, while other, less controlled search sources are restricted.

settings.name: Allow Find My Files
settings.description: Controls whether users can configure Search to Find My Files mode, which searches secondary hard drives and locations outside the user profile.
settings.rationale: Disabling Find My Files completely removes the ability to search files outside the user's own profile, reducing the risk of inadvertently exposing content the user would not normally have browsed to.

settings.id: Allow Indexing of Encrypted Stores or Items
settings.name: Allow Indexing of Encrypted Stores or Items
settings.description: Controls whether encrypted files and stores are decrypted and indexed by Windows Search.
settings.rationale: Preventing indexing of encrypted items avoids decrypted content or metadata being written into the search index, keeping sensitive, encrypted data out of a store that is not subject to the same access controls.

settings.name: Allow Search Highlights
settings.description: Controls whether Search Highlights (dynamic, cloud-curated content) are shown in search home and the taskbar/Start menu search box.
settings.rationale: Disabling Search Highlights removes cloud-curated promotional and informational content from the search experience, limiting unnecessary data retrieval and keeping the search UI focused on local and work content.

settings.name: Allow Search to Use Location
settings.description: Controls whether Search can access location information to provide location-aware search results.
settings.rationale: Blocking Search from using location information reduces the amount of sensitive location data processed by the search platform, limiting privacy exposure without affecting core search functionality.

settings.name: Disable Removable Drive Indexing
settings.description: Prevents locations on removable drives from being added to libraries and from being indexed by Windows Search.
settings.rationale: Removable drives can be disconnected, lost, or shared between devices; excluding them from indexing prevents potentially sensitive content on removable media from being cached in the local search index.

settings.name: Do Not Use Web Results
settings.description: Controls whether Search performs queries on the web and displays web results alongside local search results.
settings.rationale: Disabling web results in Search keeps queries limited to local and organizational content, reducing the amount of search telemetry sent to external services and avoiding mixing of untrusted web content with local search results.

settings.name: Prevent Remote Queries
settings.description: Controls whether other computers can query this device's search index remotely when browsing network shares hosted on it.
settings.rationale: Preventing remote queries of the local index stops other clients from using this device's index when browsing its shared folders, reducing the attack surface exposed through the Windows Search service.

changelog.notes: Release of Windows Search Management baseline version 1.0.0, converted from an Intune Settings Catalog export.
